drivers.notes: Qts 0.28, Vas 48 L, EBP 175 Hz, 65 mm edgewound aluminium coil on fiberglass former, 2.7 kg net, neo. Continuous program power 600 W (nominal 300 W). Minimum impedance 6.0 ohm. Recommended enclosure 30 L tuned to 55 Hz. Datasheet says the low pass can go as high as 2 kHz. Sd x Xmax is about 242 cm3. Le is lower than the 10M600 (0.7 vs 1.28 mH), and sensitivity is 6 dB lower (96 vs 102 dB); both 10M600 values checked against its datasheet. Rated for line arrays, 60 Hz to 6 kHz. The sister 8NW650 has Mms 26 g, Le 0.71 mH, 55 Hz to 6.3 kHz, Xmax 5.5 mm, 96 dB, cutout 185 mm, depth 111 mm (https://www.eighteensound.it/en/products/lf-driver/8-0/8/8NW650.pdf).
